title:
Epic trigger to save the feature overwrite data in the Model Scenario.
Steps:
- Updates {@link ModelScenarioApplicationState#overriddenFeatures} with the new
  [configuration](ReliabilityMlModelScenario.ValueGenerator).
- Waits for {@link ModelScenarioApplicationState#overriddenFeatures} to be updated, then:
- Refreshes the `Reliability.RunModelScenarioSensorConfigurationSensorsGrid` to reflect the changes.
- Refreshes the Model Scenario chart data using {@link ModelScenarioPlotChartDataEpic}.
name: ModelScenarioFeatureOverwriteSaveEpic
